photos.title: Failure of asphalt shingles allowing roof leakage
photos.what: A close-up of an old asphalt shingle roof above a white gutter: the colored grit is worn off in patches, the shingle flaps have shrunk, curled and torn, and dark bare mat shows where pieces are gone.
photos.caption: An asphalt shingle roof at the end of its life: the grit has worn off, and the shingle edges have curled and torn away.
photos.alt: Close-up of worn asphalt roof shingles with the grit worn off in patches and curled, torn edges above a gutter

photos.title: Termite damage
photos.what: The bottom of white-painted wood siding, eaten through in patches just above a block foundation, beside a screened foundation vent, with soil against the wall and dry leaves on the ground.
photos.caption: Termite damage in the bottom of wood siding, next to a foundation vent. A CL-100 inspector probes wood like this and reports the damage.
photos.alt: White painted wood siding eaten away by termites at its bottom edge, just above a block foundation and beside a screened vent
